newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Medical files for 2.5 mln share IPO.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Medical files for 2.5 mln share IPO.

text.p: Integrated Medical Resources Inc, a provider of disease management services for men suffering from impotence, said on Friday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of 2.5 million shares.
The shares are being sold by the company.
Hambrecht & Quist, Piper Jaffray Inc and Invemed Associates Inc will act as managing underwriters, Integrated said.
The underwriters will be granted over-allotment options on up to 375,000 shares -- up to 182,333 from certain se11ing stockholders, and up to 192,667 from the company.
Integrated said proceeds of the offering will be used for the development of additional medical clinics, repayment of debt, working capital and other general corporate purposes.
